events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller will go.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller is Ross Geller's sister.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani's weirdest place was the women's room on the second floor of the New York City public library.
Monica Geller asks what Joey Tribbiani was doing in a library.
Ross Geller says the 'It's a Small World' ride at Disneyland broke down.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Carol Willick went behind a couple of the mechanical Dutch children at the ride.
Ross Geller says the Disneyland staff fixed the ride.
Ross Geller says the Disneyland staff asked Ross Geller and Carol Willick never to return to the Magic Kingdom.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green already went.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green did not go.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green's weirdest place would have to be the foot of the bed.
Ross Geller tells Rachel Green to step back.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller have a winner.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has never had a relationship with that kind of passion.
Rachel Green says people in that kind of passionate relationship feel they have to have somebody right there in the middle of a theme park.
Ross Geller says having sex at Disneyland was the only thing to do there that did not have a line.
Rachel Green says Barry Farber would not kiss Rachel Green on a miniature golf course.
Rachel Green says Barry Farber said Barry Farber and Rachel Green were holding up the people behind them.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green did not marry Barry Farber.
Rachel Green asks Ross Geller whether there are people who go through life never having that kind of passion.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller will tell Rachel Green something.
Ross Geller says passion is way overrated.
Ross Geller affirms that passion is overrated.
Ross Geller says passion eventually burns out.
Ross Geller says that after passion burns out, people are left with trust and security, and in Ross Geller's case with his ex-wife, lesbianism.
Ross Geller says people who miss out on passion still have all the other good stuff.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller does not think Rachel Green will miss out on passion.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller sees big passion in Rachel Green's future.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller is so great.
Joey Tribbiani says a romantic relationship between Ross Geller and Rachel Green is never going to happen.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller waited too long to make Ross Geller's move.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller is in the friend zone.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is not in the friend zone.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller is the mayor of the friend zone.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is taking his time, laying the groundwork, and getting a little bit closer to asking Rachel Green out.
Joey Tribbiani says Rachel Green has no idea what Ross Geller is thinking.
Joey Tribbiani says if Ross Geller does not ask Rachel Green out soon, Ross Geller will end up stuck in the friend zone forever.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is waiting for the right moment to ask Rachel Green out.
Joey Tribbiani asks what is messing Ross Geller up, mentioning the wine, the candles, and the moonlight.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller should go up to Rachel Green and say, 'Rachel, I think that...'.
Rachel Green asks what Ross Geller is shushing.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Joey Tribbiani are shushing because they are trying to hear something.
Ross Geller tells Rachel Green to listen and asks whether Rachel Green hears the sound Ross Geller is referring to.
